name: DCA Lucky Fortune Cookery Teriyaki Chicken & Steamed White Rice Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Lucky Fortune Cookery (San Fransokyo Square · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Grilled chicken thigh/breast glazed in sweet soy teriyaki over a generous bed of steamed white jasmine rice with soft cooked carrots is 100% dairy-free, non-fried, and one of DCA's safest hot meals.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mobile-order the Teriyaki Chicken (adult or kids' portion) with steamed white rice and push aside any fibrous snap peas or cabbage.
watchOuts: Skip the Karaage-inspired crispy fried chicken sandwich (spicy slaw) and spicy Birria ramen when flaring
